column1: Well, you are the Periphery's foremost expert on ancient DropShips. If anyone can solve this problem, you say to Dr. Murad over the intercom, \"it is you.\" Dr Murad responds, \"I know the noise is coming from something in Navigation, There are too many other sounds to pinpoint the origin and I just cannot put my finger on it. If I don't find the cause, we won't be getting much sleep Commander.\" A louder bang resonates from over by the Kerby-FuCheetah Console. Dr Murad goes to investigate, \"Oh, that's interesting!\" \"Did you find out the cause?\" you ask. Dr Murad sounds surprised, \"Possibly Commander. I suspect it is coming from our newly installed Console. I've had a quick inspection of the Console, and it appears we may have a failing [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],Fu Capacitor]]. I've jiggled it and the noise has stopped for now.\" You yawn loudly, \"Let one of the ensigns on night shift keep an eye on it. Go back to bed and will deal with it as needed..\"
column2: 好吧，你可是外环区域研究古代降船的首席专家。如果有人能解决这个问题，你通过通讯器对穆拉德博士说，那个人就是你。穆拉德博士回答：“我知道噪音来自导航系统里的某个东西，但其他杂音太多，根本无法确定源头。指挥官，如果找不到原因，大家今晚都别想睡好觉。”Kerby-FuCheetah 控制台附近传来一声更响的撞击。穆拉德博士过去查看：“哦，这倒有意思！”“查到原因了吗？”你问。穆拉德博士听起来有些惊讶：“也许，指挥官。我怀疑噪音来自新装的控制台。我刚检查了一下，似乎是 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],富电容器]]出了故障。我拨弄了一下，现在暂时不响了。”你打了个大哈欠：“让值夜班的少尉留意一下。回去睡觉吧，有需要时再处理……”

column1: You hand the datapad back to Yang, \"Thanks for your hard work on this Yang. Get in touch with them and let's get this suit of Rogue Bear Battle Armour back up and running properly.\" Yang takes the datapad smiling, \"I'm on it, Boss!\" You can hear him whistling as he heads back towards the MechBay. Later on, a knock on your office door announces Yang's arrival, \"Boss, the job's done. The Baracas can now be piloted by anyone with Battle Armour experience.\" You smile, \"That is good news indeed. So how much did it cost in the end?\" Yang glances down at the datapad he's holding, \"Final bill came in at ¢2,400,000 C-Bills.\" You wince, \"Ouch! Well, at least it was still less than they hinted at. Anything else I need to know?\" Yang nods, \"Yeah, Boss. The unlocked Baracas won't be up to the same tier level performance that [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]] was able to get out of it. The 作战套件 did not survive the unlocking process so it is now more like a 守护者ECM.\"
column2: 你把数据板递还给杨：“杨，这次辛苦你了。联系他们，把这套流氓熊战斗装甲修好，让它恢复正常运行。”杨笑着接过数据板：“交给我吧，老板！”他吹着口哨朝机甲舱走去。 后来，你的办公室门被敲响，杨走了进来：“老板，事情办妥了。现在任何有战斗装甲操作经验的人都能驾驶Baracas了。” 你笑道：“这确实是个好消息。最后花了多少钱？”杨低头看了看手里的数据板：“最终账单是 ¢2,400,000 星币。” 你皱起眉头：“哎哟！至少比他们暗示的价格低。还有别的要告诉我吗？”杨点点头：“有，老板。解锁后的Baracas性能达不到 [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]] 原本能发挥的同等水平。解锁过程中作战套件受损，现在更像一套守护者 ECM。”

column1: “档案并没有丢失，根本就不存在任何证明这架 VTOL 属于我的记录。我是氏族的真血战士，绝不会让人看见我驾驶那种东西。不过，我可不会对着送到嘴边的 VTOL 挑三拣四，”你说。“叫上苏米尔，把 [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_AWACS],AWACS]] 装上豹式，运回阿尔戈号。” 杨点点头，快步走出房间，往机甲库去。 你等着。 几秒钟后，他又从原路走了回来，从另一扇门出去，朝舰桥方向去了。他看到你注意到了这次失误，脸上死灰，但什么也没说，这回总算朝正确的方向去找苏米尔了。 大约一小时后，你发现自己的公司骄傲地拥有了一架 AWACS 指挥 VTOL。
